Hi Lena —

Great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what you need to create a purchase requisition (PR) and vendor record: 

- Scope: 3-month pilot, up to 50k tokens/day, dedicated capacity during business hours (M-F).
- Commercial path check: can you confirm whether Beacon will process via PO (preferred) or corporate card? Also let us know if you prefer purchasing via AWS Marketplace (Redwood listing) — that can sometimes speed approval but requires vendor linkage.
- Supplier setup: attached is our standard Supplier_Form_Coupa.xlsx and a short Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf describing invoicing details. We can also provide the company W-9 and a signed master services agreement if needed.
- Timeline: if procurement has the supplier form + W-9, what is your typical turnaround for vendor creation + PR issuance?

Action items:
- Lena: confirm PO vs card and preferred procurement system (Coupa vs Ariba) and estimated timeline.
- Sean: provide legal name, tax ID, and any other doc you request.
- Marissa/Priyom: standby to fill supplier form and upload to the portal.

Attachments: Supplier_Form_Coupa.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf (PDF).

Thanks again — looking forward to moving this to PR creation so we can get the pilot started next month.

Best,

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the clear recap. Procurement prefers to use a PO (net 30) for vendor relationships like this. We operate in Coupa, but we also accept vendors via Ariba in specific cases. AWS Marketplace is an option, however vendor onboarding into our Coupa instance is still required for spend visibility, so routing through Coupa will be the usual path.

What we need from you to create the vendor:
- Completed supplier setup form (attached).
- Company legal name and Tax ID (EIN).
- W-9 (PDF).
- Point of contact for billing and invoicing.

Estimated timeline: once we have the completed form + W-9, vendor creation typically takes 5–10 business days. PR routing after vendor creation is usually another 3–5 business days depending on approvals.

If you can get the docs to me this week I can prioritize vendor creation. I will create the supplier record in Coupa and share the supplier ID back to you.

Regards,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager, Beacon Health
